headline: Payton Tolle brings the heat during ninth straight Red Sox win
morning_brew: Payton Tolle was absolutely untouchable at Fenway last night, carving up the Athletics with a career-high strikeout count that left the visitors looking lost at the plate. Watching him command the zone for six full frames made me feel like I was witnessing something truly special. When you combine that kind of pitching dominance with a lineup that refuses to stop putting up crooked numbers, you get a blowout win that lets the whole stadium breathe a little easier for once.

Wilyer Abreu came through with the big hits we needed, driving in three runs to keep the pressure on all night long. Even cousin Jimmy, who once tripped over his own feet while trying to celebrate a routine flyout at a backyard BBQ, would have been impressed by the way this team is clicking on all cylinders right now. We put up double-digit runs and played clean baseball, which is a massive relief compared to the cardiac-event nail-biters we were grinding through earlier this week.

With nine wins in a row, the momentum is undeniably real and we are finally seeing this squad realize their potential. We get to run it back against the Athletics before hitting the road for Toronto, and I am not gonna look ahead to the schedule or talk about the standings too much for fear of jinxing this run. For today, I am just enjoying the fact that we have the hottest team in the league playing right here in the Hub.

news_digest.headline: Payton Tolle dialed in as Red Sox win 9th straight
news_digest.dans_take: When the starter gives you that much length, it changes the whole dynamic for the rest of the staff.

news_digest.headline: Jaylen Brown says trade to Sixers has been 'crazy transition'
news_digest.dans_take: Hearing him talk about the lack of communication just confirms that the whole front-office mess went sideways in a hurry.

trend_watch.dans_take: That was as surgical a performance as I've seen from a starter all summer, straight-up clinic.
He is finding his spots and making pitchers pay for every mistake like he's holding a grudge.

trend_watch.trend: Three scoreless innings to secure the save
trend_watch.dans_take: The arson squad took the night off, and I didn't even have to watch through my fingers.
